validation_notes: The right side of the chart shows a sharp V-shaped reversal off the ~190 low near late July, followed by a strong, steep rally to ~220. This is a recovery/breakout move, not a compression pattern. There's no flat support line with lower highs converging - instead price made one clear higher low and then broke out aggressively with expanding range and rising volume. No consistent descending upper trendline with multiple touches is visible; the highs from mid-July (~210) to now (~223) are actually rising, not falling, which contradicts a descending triangle's lower-highs requirement. This looks like a failed/absent triangle setup - more of a bottoming reversal already in progress than a coiling consolidation with an apex still ahead.
